name: nexus_oauth_login
description:
Start the OAuth2 authorization-code flow: returns the URL the user opens in a browser.

Step 1 of the OAuth flow - run this first, then pass the redirect 'code'
to nexus_oauth_exchange. Uses PKCE S256 + random state. Bearer tokens then
take precedence over NEXUS_API_KEY for user-context mutations.

Returns:
    JSON {authorize_url, redirect_uri, state, instructions}.

redirect_uri.description: Override the callback URI. Must match the one registered with Nexus; override with env NEXUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI.
redirect_uri.title: Redirect Uri

scope.description: Space-separated OAuth scope. 'public' (or '') suffices for API access; 'public openid' adds identity.
scope.title: Scope
